title: Facility Networks, Automation & Logistics Integration
objective: Implement built-facility network adapters over MERA interfaces for power/fluid/air/heat/data/magic/setting-defined networks, bounded sensor/controller condition→authorized-operation bindings, Inventory storage/conveyance/routing interfaces, definition-supported throughput/capacity/priority projections, production-facility bindings to ICF/MIB-12/Economy truth, PCA-12 analysis adapters, and safe stop/failure/recovery explanations without creating a second engineering graph, automation language, inventory ledger, or production recipe engine.
acceptance: Facility network topology references canonical MERA interfaces and owner-backed nodes/connections rather than creating an MBES engineering graph.
Automation is bounded condition→authorized operation request and cannot bypass permissions, preconditions, spending/transfer validation or human/GM decisions.
Inventory/storage/conveyance/routing adapters preserve canonical quantity and custody; routing never duplicates inventory.
Throughput/capacity/priority projections and PCA analysis are used only where explicit definitions/models support them; timeout/unsupported stays inconclusive.
Production facility capability binds accepted ICF/MIB-12/Economy recipe/operation truth rather than duplicating production logic.
Network preview, failure, safe-stop and recovery paths do not silently mutate live facility state and remain semantically accessible/provider-off.
boundaries: MERA retains generic engineering topology/interface/dependency/failure authority.
GPR plus target owners retain operation execution/permission authority.
Inventory/Asset retains quantity, custody, storage and item truth.
ICF/MIB-12/Economy retain production, transformation and economic truth.
PCA-12/Packet-08 retain generic flow/capacity/cycle analysis machinery.
MBES-08 creates no generic automation language, engineering graph, inventory ledger, production recipe engine, Project ledger, or provenance ledger.
MBES-12 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-08 closeout.
next_action: Awaiting owner Continue; the next Continue starts only MBES-08.
